External Communication

Peilung bestätigen

Instruction to verify and report the direction of an object or navigational aid from the vessel, usually in degrees relative to the ship's heading or true north.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Peilung bestätigen?

In this glossary, Peilung bestätigen refers to: Instruction to verify and report the direction of an object or navigational aid from the vessel, usually in degrees relative to the ship's heading or true north.

How is Peilung bestätigen used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Brücke, bestätigen Sie die Peilung der isolierten Gefahrenmarke querab und melden Sie dies umgehend an das VTS."

Why does Peilung bestätigen matter in maritime?

Peilung bestätigen matters because it supports clear communication in External Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Peilung bestätigen?

Peilung bestätigen is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Peilung bestätigen belong to?

In this glossary, Peilung bestätigen is grouped under External Communication. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

Instruction to verify and report the direction of an object or navigational aid from the vessel, usually in degrees relative to the ship's heading or true north.

Operational example

Bridge, confirm bearing of isolated danger mark abeam and report to VTS immediately.

Localized term
